pr.title: Align independent Jenkins source diagnostics
pr.body:
Six original Jenkins inputs were left unverified because the worker and independent Rust admission disagreed about negative diagnostic precedence. Declarative V2 now aligns source-order lexical exclusions and known-malformed interpolation prefixes, with bounded handling of parenthesized slash and flat interpolation segments. Full Groovy parsing and AST checks still apply to eligible inputs. V1 evidence, the runnable grammar, fixture expectations, and disabled-by-default behavior are preserved.

Exact head `c94d232` passed 34 Rust tests, strict Clippy, and 13 Clojure tests with 285 assertions. Seventeen reduced cases include the review counterexample; disabling the malformed-prefix precheck restores 14 failures. Fresh worker captures and independent Rust replays passed all 46 preregistered fixture responses and all 228 corpus sources: 1 admitted, 216 unsupported, 11 rejected, zero unverified. These responses are byte-identical to the earlier V2 capture; only the worker-image receipt binding changed. The population remains 226 exact originals plus two previously retained redacted representations.

This includes the earned workspace/lease predecessor closures and adds JCOMP-002C as the immediate correction ticket. JCOMP-002C and JCOMP-003 remain ACTIVE pending protected merge and exact-main verification. JCOMP-003 will collect fresh paired evidence separately.

The bounded `docs/evidence/jcomp-002c-v1/` package preserves historical tested source `2326a63`, six before/after pairs, campaign manifests, test/mutation logs, independent reviews, and a verified source recovery bundle. The new exact-`c94d232` verification receipt is retained in the P2 review reply. Full raw captures and build metadata remain locally retained; the committed subset is not a complete offline replay inventory.
